# Model Overview (for Diagnosis)
The probe requires the actual trained `NextItNetModel` at `view.model`. It inspects item embeddings and intermediate `NextItNetBlock` outputs. `view.log2feats(sequence)` supplies finite FP32 representations shaped B × L × H; backbone computation is delegated to that adapter. Scoring gathers the final nonpadding position using the maximum occupied index, correctly handling left padding.

# Diagnosis Inputs & Hooks
`DiagnosisProbe(view, device)` accesses `item_emb`, `user_train`, `log2feats`, and `predict_score`. The loader provides `(None, sequence, positive, negative)` with aligned B × L tensors. Encoded histories and targets are matched against training endpoints; ambiguous matches are rejected. Up to 32 users contribute one event each, with a target and up to 99 unique unseen alternatives.

Forward hooks capture or replace the final occupied position at two strictly intermediate residual blocks. Diagnosis temporarily enables evaluation mode and deterministic FP32 execution, then restores modes, backend settings, RNG states, and hooks.

# Probes & Metrics
Every measured outcome is `[target-minus-best-alternative margin, target rank, diagnostic HR@10]`. Larger margins, lower ranks, and higher hit rates indicate stronger target ranking. Sensitivity itself is neither inherently good nor bad.

Summaries average draws within users, then weight users equally, reporting all/repeat/novel strata. Conditional 95% user-bootstrap intervals require at least ten users. Endpoint-minus-ordering comparisons use common users. Matched-donor summaries report descriptive means, quantiles, and reuse without confidence intervals.

Embedding-collapse and loader-wide positive/negative-margin helpers exist but are **not invoked** by `run_full_diagnosis`.

# Perturbation & Tests
Stage 1 permutes earlier occupied items or replaces the endpoint, with three draws each. Stage 2 runs only when candidate scores change beyond numerical tolerance: clean activations restore corrupted recipients, and corrupted activations disrupt clean recipients. Additional donors match original history length and endpoint.

Controls check readout agreement, batch consistency, bounded future invariance, repeatability, hook layout/padding, and no-op/identity patches. Failed sites invalidate their patch results.

# MODEL_DIAGNOSIS Schema & Limitations
The returned object contains `metrics` and `metric_definitions`. Metrics include status, summaries, comparisons, donor summaries, controls, coverage, errors, numerical configuration, timing, and replay-manifest location.

Measurements concern training-history sensitivity, not host validation or generalization. Export parity and complete dependency paths remain unverified. Missing metadata, sparse donors, numerical gating, hybrid activations, and the 120-second category budget limit interpretation; unavailable measurements never establish health.
